title: Make All Zwischenbericht Element References Clickable
description: Every in-document reference to a numbered element in mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht must be a clickable hyperlink. Concretely: the hardcoded plain-text "Tabelle 2.1.a" in zwischenbericht.tex (Soll-Ist-Vergleich) must become \tableref pointing at the "Förderrechtliche Meilensteine" Table (which needs a key=), and the vague "Die folgende Tabelle" in anhang/user-stories.tex must become a \tableref at the "Systemarchitektur" Table. Audit the whole report (main text + all anhang/*.tex) for any other prose reference to a table, figure, appendix, part or section that is not already a live \tableref/\appendixref/\hyperref/\ref, and convert it. Verify by building the PDF and inspecting the link annotations that every reference resolves to a correct /GoTo destination and that there are no undefined references.
summary: Audited every prose cross-reference in the Zwischenbericht (zwischenbericht.tex plus all anhang/*.tex) and converted the three that were not live links. (1) The hardcoded plain-text "Tabelle 2.1.a" in \section{Soll-Ist-Vergleich} now uses \tableref{tab:meilensteine}; the "Förderrechtliche Meilensteine" Table gained key=tab:meilensteine and \tableref resolves to exactly "Tabelle 2.1.a", so the rendered wording is unchanged. (2) "im Abschnitt Soll-Ist-Vergleich" (Arbeitspakete/AP-Erfahrung status text) now reads \hyperref[abschnitt:soll-ist-vergleich]{Abschnitt~\ref*{...}} — matching the existing \hyperref[teil:ergebnisse]{Teil~\ref*{...}} convention already used in the same section — with a new \label{abschnitt:soll-ist-vergleich} on the section. (3) The vague "Die folgende Tabelle dient als Leselogik" in anhang/user-stories.tex now names its target via \tableref{tab:systemarchitektur}, with key=tab:systemarchitektur added to the "Systemarchitektur" Table. Only the light source was edited; .semio-dark/zwischenbericht-dark.tex is generated by print/script.ts deriveDarkTexSource and is not committed. Verified by a forced rebuild (--skip-nx-cache) of both variants: no undefined references or citations in either log, and .aux resolves the labels to 2.1 / 2.1.a / US.SA.a. Inspected the PDF link annotations with pypdf (.repo ticket folder verify-links.py): in both light and dark PDFs the three converted references carry /GoTo destinations semiotable.1, section.2.1 and semiotable.37 respectively, and the 35 pre-existing \ref{us:*} entries in the Anforderungsmapping table were confirmed already clickable (subsection.appendix.7.1.*). Final regex sweep over all sources found no remaining unlinked "Tabelle/Abbildung/Abschnitt/Kapitel/Teil/Anhang <number>" or "die folgende Tabelle" style references. Untouched: print/tex/semio-core.sty and print/tex/semio-table.sty were already modified in the working tree by a concurrent session.
